# DecisionMath

DecisionMath is a hub of standalone financial decision calculators and unit conversion tools. All calculations run instantly with pure math and no external data APIs.

## Main sections
- [Calculators](https://decisionmath.pages.dev/): Lease vs buy, job offer relocation, freelance rate, mortgage refinance, and rent vs buy.
- [Conversions](https://decisionmath.pages.dev/convert/meter-to-kilometer): Dynamic source-to-destination conversion calculators.
- [Pricing](https://decisionmath.pages.dev/pricing): Free calculator use; Plus adds saved scenarios, PDF export, and comparisons.
- [About](https://decisionmath.pages.dev/about): Product purpose and informational-use disclaimer.
- [Contact](mailto:contact@calyvent.com?subject=DecisionMath%20Inquiry): Questions and feedback.

Results are estimates for decision-support only, not financial, tax, or legal advice.
